div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: PROTOCOL SCOPE / UNRESOLVED REQUIREMENTS — §5.11, §5.12, §6.3, §6.9, §8.5

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Full distributed template agreement — the Δ_tx collection window, mempool
reconciliation, TemplateID computation and verification, and pre-committed
reward enforcement — is SPECIFIED in Chapter 5 but is not implemented as
executable checks and has not been validated experimentally end to end.

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Range membership of the winning nonce does not prove that non-winning
miners searched their complete assigned ranges; contribution auditing
and contribution verification remain incomplete.

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Sybil resistance is not experimentally established; it depends on external
registration and identity policies (curated membership, or costed
registration such as a deposit or a registration proof of work).

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Incentive compatibility is not established, and quantitative reward fairness
has not been evaluated; both are stated as future work.

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PoW-equivalent common-prefix, chain-growth, chain-quality and double-spend
guarantees have not been formally proved for the complete common-template
protocol; Section 5.11 gives a preliminary informal argument only.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: SIDE MODULE · DYNAMIC MINER-SET MANAGEMENT — §5.4, §5.10

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: join

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: explicit leave

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: silent leave

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: long inactivity

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Miner-set change event?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
JOINING §5.4.1, §5.10.1
registration transaction carrying public key / identity, network address and
reward address → validated and included in block B_h → mᵢ ∈ M(r) for every
round r > h → receives a nonce range → becomes eligible under the
applicable reward rule

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
EXPLICIT LEAVING §5.4.2, §5.10.2
signed deregistration transaction → signature valid and miner still in M_h →
confirmed in a block → removed from the registered set, immediately or after
k blocks → no future nonce range and no future reward under the baseline
membership rule; previously earned rewards remain on the ledger

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SILENT LEAVING / INACTIVITY §5.4.3, §5.10.2
identity remains registered · Hᵢ(r) = 0 · the assigned nonce range may remain
unevaluated · effective active hash rate decreases · the miner is still paid
under the baseline equal-sharing rule until it deregisters or is removed

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OPTIONAL LONG-TERM-INACTIVITY REMOVAL §5.4.4, §5.10.3
if h − ℓᵢ(h) > Θ_inact the miner becomes eligible for forced removal: any
honest node may propose a removal transaction, and once it is included
mᵢ ∉ M(r) for all subsequent rounds r > h

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: PHASE 9 · COMMITMENT, STATE UPDATE AND ROUND TRANSITION — §5.8.5, §5.10

Append B_r to the blockchain · update balances in S(B_r),

span.p:
Process miner registration, deregistration and inactivity-removal
transactions → update the registered miner set M_(r+1)

span.p:
CHECK 1 · Previous-block linkage
prevhash matches B_(r−1) in the local ledger; the block extends the
longest valid chain or a competing chain of comparable length

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CHECK 3 · Transactions and Merkle root
the transaction list and Merkle root match the common template and
T_reward(r) is identical to the pre-committed reward transaction

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CHECK 5 · Transaction validity
validate every transaction against S(B_(r−1)):
no double spending, correct state transitions, valid ledger rules

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CHECK 6 · Reward-distribution validity §5.9.2
recompute R_tot(r), M_r and the shares sᵢ, then verify
completeness · correctness · conservation · ledger validity

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CHECK 7 · Proof of work
H(Serialize(Header_r(n_success))) ≤ Target, and the header Merkle root
and committed fields are consistent with BlockTemplate_r

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CHECK 8 · Template identifier
a header meeting the target but built from different non-nonce fields carries
TemplateID ≠ TemplateID_r and is REJECTED regardless of its valid PoW

and the chain-selection rules

standard Nakamoto-style fork resolution

span.p: PHASE 7 · ROUND OUTCOME · UNEVALUATED RANGES AND NO-SOLUTION ROUNDS — §5.6.5, §5.8.4

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Yes · no-solution round

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
All ranges assigned to ACTIVE miners exhausted, no header at or
below the target, and no valid block received?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Round r ends WITHOUT a block · no miner may alter a non-nonce
consensus-critical field and continue under the same round identifier

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Create a NEW round · derive a new canonical template ·
compute a new TemplateID · compute a new round seed ·
generate new nonce assignments · restart the collaborative search

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center; width: 560px;

span.p:
ALL ACTIVE RANGES EXHAUSTED ≠ THE PERMITTED NONCE DOMAIN IS EXHAUSTED.
When a registered miner is inactive, a nonce satisfying the target may lie inside
its assigned range and never be evaluated in this round; the round is then closed
and a new round with a new template is generated (§5.6.5).

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: PHASE 6 · POST-RANGE OPERATING POLICIES — alternatives, declared per configuration — §5.6.6

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: energy saving

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: continuous performance

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Configured post-range
operating policy?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ENERGY-SAVING IDLE POLICY §5.6.6.1
stop active hashing · enter a low-power idle / listening state until the
end of the current collaborative round · stay connected to the network ·
may receive notice that another miner produced a valid block ·
perform no further mining hashes during the remaining round

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Wait for a valid block or for the termination of round r

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CONTINUOUS-PERFORMANCE POLICY §5.6.6.2
do not idle · continue with newly assigned, non-overlapping work
bound to an explicitly identified template or sub-round

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Active hashing → low-power state IS the energy-saving mechanism.
The saving comes from the active/idle power difference and the idle duration,
NOT from nonce partitioning alone. The policy also lowers the active network
hash rate, so its effects on block interval, range-exhaustion probability,
liveness and security must be evaluated together with its savings.

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
“End of the current collaborative mining round” denotes the round deadline
or target block interval defined by PoCol — not a multi-block
difficulty-adjustment epoch (§5.6.6.1).

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
At equal aggregate hash rate, hardware efficiency, active power and
experiment duration, continuous operation is not expected to reduce energy;
its purpose is performance-oriented and any gain must be reported as an
empirical result, not as a consequence of nonce-range separation.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: PHASE 5 · COLLABORATIVE PROOF-OF-WORK SEARCH — all active miners in parallel — §5.8.4

span.p: Miner mᵢ takes only the nonce values n ∈ R_r(mᵢ)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Registered but INACTIVE miner mᵢ ∈ M_r , mᵢ ∉ A_r

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Its range R_r(mᵢ) stays assigned under the deterministic
allocation but may remain unevaluated

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Effective hash rate decreases
H_eff(r) = Σ_(mᵢ ∈ A_r) Hᵢ(r) ≤ H_tot(r)
λ_blk_eff(r) = H_eff(r) · p_succ(D_r) → longer block intervals
until the difficulty adjustment responds

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Insert n into the nonce field of the common HeaderTemplate_r
→ complete candidate header Header_r(n)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Compute H(Serialize(Header_r(n)))

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: H(Serialize(Header_r(n))) ≤ Target?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Assigned range R_r(mᵢ) exhausted?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Continue with the next nonce inside the assigned range

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Mark the local assigned range as exhausted

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Miner becomes the successful proposer of round r
publish the already committed BlockTemplate_r instantiated with n_success ·
the reward transaction is NOT modified · broadcast the proposed block

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Only the NONCE varies within one active round. Changing the timestamp,
the transaction set, the reward transaction or any other consensus-critical
field yields a different template and is prohibited inside round r (§5.8.4).

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: PHASE 4 · DETERMINISTIC NONCE-DOMAIN ALLOCATION — §5.6, §5.8.3

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Round seed (5.2)
seed_r = H(“PoColNonce” ‖ h_(r−1) ‖ r ‖ TemplateID_r)
h_(r−1) = previous committed block-header hash · r = round index
TemplateID_r binds the assignment to the canonical template

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Per-round ticket of every mᵢ ∈ M_r (5.3)
ticket_r(mᵢ) = H(seed_r ‖ id(mᵢ))

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Pseudo-random deterministic ordering (5.4)
L_r = m₍₀₎, m₍₁₎, …, m₍n−1₎ sorted by increasing ticket value
ticket_r(m₍₀₎) ≤ ticket_r(m₍₁₎) ≤ … ≤ ticket_r(m₍n−1₎) , n = |M_r|

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Integer partition of the permitted nonce domain (5.4a, 5.4b)
start_r(i) = ⌊ i · N_max / n ⌋
end_r(i) = ⌊ (i+1) · N_max / n ⌋ − 1

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Assigned range of the miner at position i (5.5)
R_r(m₍ᵢ₎) = [ start_r(i) , end_r(i) ]

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PARTITION PROPERTIES §5.6.3
• No overlap R_r(mᵢ) ∩ R_r(m_j) = ∅ for i ≠ j
• Complete coverage ⋃ᵢ R_r(m₍ᵢ₎) = N
• Approximately balanced |R_r(m₍ᵢ₎)| ∈ ⌊N_max/n⌋ , ⌈N_max/n⌉

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
N = 0, 1, …, N_max − 1 is the PERMITTED NONCE DOMAIN of the round
(e.g. 2³² or 2⁶⁴ depending on implementation constraints); it is NOT the
SHA-256 output space. Every honest miner recomputes the ordering and its
own range locally from public inputs — there is no trusted range coordinator.

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DISJOINT-EVALUATION INVARIANT §5.8.3
For every pair of distinct honest miners, R_r(mᵢ) ∩ R_r(m_j) = ∅; under the
common immutable template they therefore never evaluate the same
serialized candidate header Header_r(n) during the same round.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: PHASE 3b · CANONICAL COMMON-TEMPLATE CONSTRUCTION — §5.8.2

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: No

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Yes

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Open the bounded transaction-collection window Δ_tx
exchange pending transactions by normal gossip

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Eligible transaction set of round r
received before the cutoff AND valid with respect to S(B_(r−1))

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deterministic selection and ordering rule
decreasing fee density up to the block-size limit,
ties broken by lexicographic transaction identifier

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Compute the Merkle root over the ordered transaction list

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Embed the pre-committed reward-distribution transaction T_reward(r)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Assemble the canonical BlockTemplate_r
previous-block hash · round number · protocol version · target D_r
deterministic timestamp · ordered transaction list · Merkle root
T_reward(r) · every other consensus-critical field — nonce excluded

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Derive the nonce-free header template HeaderTemplate_r
only the nonce field may vary during the active round

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: TemplateID_r = H(Encode(BlockTemplate_r without a round-specific nonce value))

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Locally derived TemplateID_r equals the network-consistent
TemplateID_r announced by peers?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Do NOT begin authorised mining · reconcile the transaction / template view
request missing transactions by identifier, validate them,
discard ineligible ones

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Recompute / re-verify the canonical template

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FREEZE the template for round r
BlockTemplate_r and HeaderTemplate_r are immutable

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
COMMON-TEMPLATE INVARIANT §5.8.2
For every round r all honest miners use the same immutable block template T_r
and the same derived nonce-free header template. A candidate block is valid for
round r only if all non-nonce consensus-critical fields match T_r; the nonce is
inserted solely to instantiate the candidate header evaluated for proof of work.

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Template agreement is reached entirely through peer-to-peer gossip of
transactions and template identifiers — no centralised coordinator exists.
The ordering rule and its tie-breaking convention are a proposed protocol
requirement of Chapter 5; the Chapter 6 prototype orders transactions by
decreasing fee only, after the winning event, with no agreement step (§6.3).

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: PHASE 3a · PRE-COMMITTED COLLABORATIVE REWARD DISTRIBUTION — §5.9

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Total distributable reward (5.6)
R_tot(r) = R_blk(r) + F_tx(r)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reward-distribution function (5.7)
f_r : M_r → [0,1] , sᵢ = f_r(mᵢ) ≥ 0 , Σ_(mᵢ ∈ M_r) f_r(mᵢ) = 1

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reward paid to each miner (5.8)
Reward_r(mᵢ) = sᵢ · R_tot(r)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Equal-sharing baseline (5.9)
f_r(mᵢ) = 1 / |M_r| for every mᵢ ∈ M_r

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Build T_reward(r): one output per mᵢ ∈ M_r paying Reward_r(mᵢ) to its
registered on-chain reward address; inputs are the subsidy R_blk(r)
and the collected fees F_tx(r); placed first in B_r

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Computed BEFORE mining begins, from S(B_(r−1)) and the protocol rules.
The baseline membership rule pays every registered miner, including inactive
ones; activity-filtered variants over M̃_r ⊆ M_r with renormalised shares are
an explicitly optional deployment variant (§5.9.3).

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: PHASE 2 · ROUND START AND COMMITTED-STATE READ, r ≥ 1 — §5.8.1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Round r starts deterministically the moment B_(r−1) is accepted

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read the committed state S(B_(r−1))
previous-block header hash h_(r−1) · registered miner set M_r
balances and application state · pending transactions (mempool)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: PHASE 1 · SYSTEM INITIALISATION / GENESIS ROUND r = 0 — §5.7

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Yes

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Initialise PoCol protocol parameters
version · difficulty target D₀ · permitted nonce-domain size N_max
subsidy R_blk · reward function f_r · tx-collection window Δ_tx

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Establish the genesis blockchain state, initial balances and ledger state

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Register the founding miner set M₀
public key · network address · reward address
bootstrapping consortium or first-miner self-registration

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
All miners agree on M₀ before
nonce-domain distribution?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Derive the canonical genesis block template BlockTemplate₀
and the nonce-free HeaderTemplate₀, including the initial
reward-distribution transaction and any bootstrap transactions

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: TemplateID₀ = H(Encode(BlockTemplate₀ without round-specific nonce))

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Every miner verifies TemplateID₀?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: seed₀ = H(“PoColNonce” ‖ genesis_hash ‖ 0 ‖ TemplateID₀)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deterministic nonce-domain allocation
ticket₀(mᵢ) → ordered list L₀ → disjoint ranges R₀(mᵢ)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Start the first collaborative search
instantiate Header₀(n) for n ∈ R₀(mᵢ)

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: H(Serialize(Header₀(n))) ≤ Target?

div.style: color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 16, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: Commit B₀ · initialise state S(B₀) with balances and M₀

div.style: color: rgb(32, 32, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Genesis obeys the same round rules: if the assigned ranges are
exhausted without a solution, a new template and a new round
are derived before the search resumes (§5.8.4).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: START · PoCol network deployment
